steps: Read existing RoundLoop to ensure distinctness (it uses a linear wave list + gate-blocked TestAutoKill)
Authored ReplicatedStorage.OnslaughtConfig: Arena ring geo, enemy Tiers with credit costs, and Rounds as credit BUDGETS with maxAlive cap + trickle cadence + tier weights
Authored ServerScriptService.OnslaughtDirector: per-round the director trickle-spends the credit budget, spawning affordable weighted tiers from a golden-angle ring while under the concurrency cap
Round clears when budget spent AND field empty; live count tracked via Humanoid.Died / AncestryChanged (player kills only)
Prints [Onslaught] tagged lifecycle: system start, breather, round start, each spawn, budget spent, round CLEARED, VICTORY
Verified both modules compile, EnemyTemplate has a Humanoid, and no gate-blocked auto-kill symbols present

recipe.text: Fresh concept: a spawn-CREDIT DIRECTOR (not a flat wave list). Each round is a credit budget the director trickle-spends, picking weighted affordable enemy tiers (grunt/brute) from a ring under a concurrency cap. A round advances only when the budget is exhausted AND the field is clear, so player combat drives progression; VICTORY prints after the final round. Config-driven via ReplicatedStorage.OnslaughtConfig; state exposed on Workspace attributes OnslaughtRound/OnslaughtAlive/OnslaughtState. No auto-kill hook.
